name: FAFAMOON Peptide Lip Tint 10ml
description:
FAFAMOON Peptide Lip Tint 10ml 
Peptide-Infused Formula: Enhances lip health by nourishing and hydrating. 
Vibrant Colors: Delivers a natural, long-lasting tint. 
Lightweight Texture: Comfortable for all-day wear without feeling sticky. 
Moisturizing Benefits: Keeps lips soft and smooth, preventing dryness. 
Buildable Coverage: Allows for a sheer or bold look based on application. 
Long-Lasting Effect: Stays vibrant for hours with minimal touch-ups.
